main_text.p: efficere posse, quin institutus sit, quip-pe qui suus aliquo tempore fuit: sed ta-men sua sponte aditurum iccirco, quia mortis tempore in familia non erat.
main_text.head: LEGIS LECTA, 40.D. SI CERT. PETAT. INTERPRETATIO.
ARGVMENTVM.
main_text.p: Pactum de forte per partes soluen-da, continenter adiectum stipulationi fortis & usurarum, ita per uniuersam stipulationem fusum intelligitur, ut etiam usurarum obligationem pro ra-ta pensionum diuisisse iudicetur.
main_text.head: TEXTVS.
main_text.p: PAVLVS libro III. Questionū: LECTA est in auditorio Ae-milij Papiniani, præ-torio, Iurisconsulti, cautio huiusmodi. Lucius Titius scripsi, me accepisse à Publio Mę-uio

page.notes: The running head is decorated and could not be read. The line ending "præ torio" may carry a printed hyphen; I have written it as "præ-torio" but the scan does not show it clearly. "Questionū" is read with a plain s; the scan may show a ligature here. The bottom ornament (a small bullet) is printer's decoration and was left out.
